name: Edward R. Blumberg
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Miami, Florida
side_practice_areas: Medical Malpractice, Personal Injury, Products Liability
about: Attorney Edward R. Blumberg is a partner at Deutsch Blumberg & Caballero, P.A., in Miami, Florida. A seasoned trial lawyer with more than 40 years of experience, Mr. Blumberg devotes his law practice to personal injury, including medical and dental malpractice, product liability, insurance coverage disputes and other issues, representing the injured and their families throughout Florida.

Mr. Blumberg holds a bachelor’s degree from the University of Georgia and a law degree from William & Mary Law School. He has also been certified in civil trial law by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. He is admitted to practice in the state of Florida and is licensed to appear before the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the Fifth and Eleventh circuits and the Supreme Court of the United States.

Over the course of his career, Mr. Blumberg has been deeply involved with many professional organizations and committees. He is a past president of The Florida Bar and also served on its Board of Governors. He has also served on the House of Delegates for the American Bar Association and as a member of the Trial Bar of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida. He continues to sit on the board of directors for community organizations and frequently gives presentations for continuing legal education seminars.

Recognized for his accomplishments and contributions to the legal profession, Mr. Blumberg has earned the highest possible rating of AV Preeminent* from the respected peer review service Martindale-Hubbell. He is also listed in the publication “The Best Lawyers in America.”

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
